newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit hits three-year low vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit hits three-year low vs dollar.

text.p: The ringgit hit a three-year low against the dollar in early afternoon trade on Friday on sales by offshore players, dealers said.
At 0550 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.6050/70 to a dollar, its weakest level since July 1994.
"Funds are still behind the ringgit selling," said a dealer with a Malaysian bank. "I think they are trying to take it across 2.61."
He said rate movements were exaggerated by large spread of 30 to 50 points.
Dealers said the central Bank Negara was not seen in the market despite the dollar's climb beyond the 2.6000 mark. It was earlier heard checking rates at that level.
The ringgit had fallen more than three percent this week due to selling by speculative funds.
